xtDim = Color3.fromRGB(200, 160, 165),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(210, 160, 170),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(220, 150, 160),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(230, 170, 180),
}

local function colorToArray(color)
    return {
        math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5),
    }
end

    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(50, 80, 140),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(70, 110, 170),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 240),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(100, 160, 240),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
}

local function arrayToColor(value, fallback)
    if type(value) == "table" then
        local r = tonumber(value[1] or value.R)
        local g = tonumber(value[2] or value.G)
        local b = tonumber(value[3] or value.B)
        if r and g and b then
            return Color3.fromRGB(
                math.clamp(math.floor(r + 0.5), 0, 255),
                math.clamp(math.floor(g + 0.5), 0, 255),
                math.clamp(math.floor(b + 0.5), 0, 255)
            )
        end
    end
    return fallback
end

    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(80, 140, 220),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
}

local function normalizeAssetId(value)
    value = tostring(value or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    if value == "" then return "" end
    local numericId = value:match("(%d+)")
    if not numericId then return nil end
    return "rbxassetid://" .. numericId
end

    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 220),
}

local function applyCustomThemeToRuntime(name, data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.Palette) ~= "table" then return false end

    local fallback = ThemePalettes.Dark
    local palette = {
        Background = arrayToColor(data.Palette.Background, fallback.Background),
        Secondary = arrayToColor(data.Palette.Secondary, fallback.Secondary),
        AccentOff = arrayToColor(data.Palette.AccentOff, fallback.AccentOff),
        Text = arrayToColor(data.Palette.Text, fallback.Text),
        TextDim = arrayToColor(data.Palette.TextDim, fallback.TextDim),
        Stroke = arrayToColor(data.Palette.Stroke, fallback.Stroke),
        Accent = arrayToColor(data.Palette.Accent, fallback.Accent),
        ToggleOn = arrayToColor(data.Palette.ToggleOn, fallback.ToggleOn),
    }

    ThemePalettes[name] = palette

    if data.Background and data.Background ~= "" then
        ThemeBackgroundImages[name] = data.Background
    else
        ThemeBackgroundImages[name] = nil
    end

    if data.Video and data.Video ~= "" then
        ThemeBackgroundVideos[name] = {
            Id = normalizeAssetId(data.Video) or data.Video,
            Looped = data.VideoLooped ~= false,
            Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(data.VideoVolume) or 0, 0, 1),
        }
    else
        ThemeBackgroundVideos[name] = nil
    end

    if data.Sound and data.Sound ~= "" then
        ThemeClickSounds[name] = data.Sound
    else
        ThemeClickSounds[name] = nil
    end

    return true
end

    pcall(function()

            writefile(CUSTOM_THEMES_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                Themes = CustomThemes,
                Order = CustomThemeOrder,
            }))
        end
    end)
end

local function LoadCustomThemes()
    if not (readfile and isfile and isfile(CUSTOM_THEMES_FILE)) then return end

    pcall(function()
        local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CUSTOM_THEMES_FILE))
        if type(decoded) ~= "table" or type(decoded.Themes) ~= "table" then return end

        CustomThemes = decoded.Themes
        CustomThemeOrder = type(decoded.Order) == "table" and decoded.Order or {}

        local seen = {}
        local cleanOrder = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(CustomThemeOrder) do
            if type(name) == "string" and CustomThemes[name] and not OfficialThemeNames[name] and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(cleanOrder, name)
            end
        end
        for name, data in pairs(CustomThemes) do
            if type(name) == "string" and not OfficialThemeNames[name] then
                if not seen[name] then
                    seen[name] = true
                    table.insert(cleanOrder, name)
                end
                applyCustomThemeToRuntime(name, data)
            end
        end
        CustomThemeOrder = cleanOrder
    end)
end

local function LoadStickers()
    local dlOk, rawData = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(STICKERS_URL, true)
    end)
    if not (dlOk and type(rawData) == "string" and #rawData > 20) then
        print("[YinYang Stickers] ⚠️ Descarga falló; se mantienen los stickers embebidos")
        return false
    end

    local parseOk, data = pcall(function()
        return loadstring(rawData)()
    end)
    rawData = nil
    if not (parseOk and type(data) == "table" and data.Stickers) then
        print("[YinYang Stickers] ❌ Error al parsear; se mantienen los stickers embebidos")
        return false
    end

    local count = 0
    for name, sticker in pairs(data.Stickers) do
        if sticker.Image then
            StickerPalettes[name] = {
                Image = sticker.Image,
                Frames = sticker.Frames,
                Interval = sticker.Interval,
                LabelES = sticker.LabelES or name,
                LabelEN = sticker.LabelEN or name,
            }
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    if data.Order then
        StickerOrder = data.Order
    end
    print("[YinYang Stickers] ✅ " .. count .. " stickers cargados en memoria (v" .. tostring(data.Version or "?") .. ")")
    return true
end

local function LoadIcons()
    local rawData = nil

    local dlOk, dlResult = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(ICONS_URL, true)
    end)

    if dlOk and type(dlResult) == "string" and #dlResult > 20 then
        rawData = dlResult
        print("[YinYang Icons] ✅ Iconos descargados desde repo")
    else
        print("[YinYang Icons] ⚠️ Descarga falló; se mantiene ClassicYinYang embebido")
    end

    if rawData then
        local parseOk, data = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(rawData)()
        end)

        if parseOk and type(data) == "table" and data.Icons then
            IconCatalog.Icons   = data.Icons
            IconCatalog.Version = data.Version or 1
            if data.Order then
                IconCatalog.Order = data.Order
            end
            local count = 0
            for _ in pairs(data.Icons) do count = count + 1 end
            print("[YinYang Icons] ✅ " .. count .. " iconos cargados (v" .. tostring(data.Version or "?") .. ")")
            return true
        else
            print("[YinYang Icons] ❌ Error al parsear datos de iconos")
        end
    else
        print("[YinYang Icons] ❌ Sin datos, usando fallback embebido")
    end

    return false
end

            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    print("[YinYang Classic] ✅ " .. count .. " scripts externos en el manifest")
    return data
end

local function mk(cls, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(cls)
    pcall(function() o.Selectable = false end)
    if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
        pcall(function() o.AutoLocalize = false end)
    end
    if o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("ImageButton") then
        pcall(function() o.AutoButtonColor = false end)
    end
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end

-- ==================== SPRITESHEET SUPPORT ====================
-- Opcional: una capa puede declarar layerDef.SpriteSheet con la misma
-- estructura usada por SpriteSheetTest_v2. Las capas normales no cambian.
local function normalizeSpriteSheetConfig(config)
    if type(config) ~= "table" or type(config.SheetIds) ~= "table" or #config.SheetIds == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local columns = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(config.Columns) or 1))
    local rows = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(config.Rows) or 1))
    local frameWidth = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(config.FrameWidth) or 1))
    local frameHeight = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(config.FrameHeight) or 1))
    local fps = math.clamp(tonumber(config.FPS) or 24, 1, 60)

    local framesPerSheet = {}
    local totalFrames = 0
    for i = 1, #config.SheetIds do
        local n = tonumber(type(config.FramesPerSheet) == "table" and config.FramesPerSheet[i]) or (columns * rows)
        n = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, columns * rows)
        framesPerSheet[i] = n
        totalFrames = totalFrames + n
    end

    if totalFrames <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local cropContent = config.CropContent == true
    local rectHeight = cropContent and math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(config.CropHeight) or frameHeight)) or frameHeight
    local rectYShift = cropContent and math.floor(tonumber(config.CropY) or 0) or 0

    return {
        SheetIds = config.SheetIds,
        Columns = columns,
        Rows = rows,
        FrameWidth = frameWidth,
        FrameHeight = frameHeight,
        FramesPerSheet = framesPerSheet,
        FPS = fps,
        RectHeight = rectHeight,
        RectYShift = rectYShift,
        TotalFrames = totalFrames,
    }
end

local function createSpriteSheetLabels(parent, config, size, position, zIndex)
    local cfg = normalizeSpriteSheetConfig(config)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end

    local labels = {}
    for i, id in ipairs(cfg.SheetIds) do
        local label = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = size,
            Position = position,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = tostring(id):find("rbxassetid://", 1, true) and tostring(id) or ("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)),
            ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(cfg.FrameWidth, cfg.RectHeight),
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, cfg.RectYShift),
            ImageTransparency = (i == 1) and 0 or 1,
            ScaleType = config.ScaleType or Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            ZIndex = zIndex or 30,
        })
        labels[i] = label
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _, label in ipairs(labels) do
            if label.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ label })
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    local state = {
        Config = cfg,
        Labels = labels,
        Frame = 0,
        Acc = 0,
        CurrentSheet = 1,
    }

    return labels[1], state
end

local function updateSpriteSheetFrame(state, frame)
    if not state or not state.Config then return end

    local cfg = state.Config
    local target = math.clamp(math.floor(frame or 0), 0, cfg.TotalFrames - 1)
    local remaining = target
    local sheetIndex = 1

    for i, count in ipairs(cfg.FramesPerSheet) do
        if remaining < count then
            sheetIndex = i
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - count
    end

    local localIndex = remaining
    local column = localIndex % cfg.Columns
    local row = math.floor(localIndex / cfg.Columns)

    if sheetIndex ~= state.CurrentSheet then
        if state.Labels[state.CurrentSheet] then
            state.Labels[state.CurrentSheet].ImageTransparency = 1
        end
        if state.Labels[sheetIndex] then
            state.Labels[sheetIndex].ImageTransparency = 0
        end
        state.CurrentSheet = sheetIndex
    end

    local label = state.Labels[sheetIndex]
    if label then
        label.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(
            column * cfg.FrameWidth,
            row * cfg.FrameHeight + cfg.RectYShift
        )
    end

    state.Frame = target
end
-- ==================== SPRITE DE FONDO DE TEMA ====================
-- Un tema puede declarar Sprite = { SheetIds, Columns, Rows, FrameWidth,
-- FrameHeight, FramesPerSheet, FPS }. Tambien acepta el formato antiguo
-- { Ids, Columns, Rows, FrameWidth, FrameHeight, FrameCount, FPS }.
--
-- COMO FUNCIONA EL FONDO ANIMADO (SPRITE) DE UN TEMA
--
-- 1) DATOS (archivo de temas). Cada "hoja" (sheet) es una imagen subida a Roblox
--    como Image. Contiene una cuadricula de Columns x Rows frames de FrameWidth x
--    FrameHeight px. Orden de los frames: izquierda a derecha, arriba a abajo.
--    - SheetIds (o Ids): las hojas, en orden de reproduccion.
--    - FramesPerSheet: cuantos frames reales tiene cada hoja (la ultima suele quedar
--      incompleta). Con el formato antiguo basta FrameCount (total de frames).
--    - Una hoja de 4x5 celdas de 256x192 mide 1024x960 (Roblox limita a ~1024 px por lado).
--
-- 2) CARGA. LoadThemes guarda theme.Sprite en ThemeSprites[nombreDelTema] y lo borra
--    si el tema ya no lo trae.
--
-- 3) AL APLICAR UN TEMA, Window:SetTheme llama applyThemeSprite(self, BackgroundArt, sprite):
--    a) stopThemeSprite destruye las capas y la conexion del sprite anterior.
--    b) toThemeSpriteConfig valida el Sprite (acepta SheetIds o Ids) y calcula los
--       frames de cada hoja; si es invalido avisa con warn y se usa Background.
--    c) Se vacia BackgroundArt.Image y se crea UNA ImageLabel por hoja DENTRO de
--       BackgroundArt (createSpriteSheetLabels). Cada una ya tiene su Image y su
--       ImageRectSize (= tamano de UN frame). Solo la hoja actual se ve
--       (ImageTransparency 0); las demas estan en 1. Asi no se reasigna Image durante
--       el loop, lo que puede dar un parpadeo borroso al cambiar de hoja.
--    d) Las hojas se precargan con ContentProvider:PreloadAsync (en segundo plano).
--    e) Un RenderStepped acumula el tiempo y avanza 1 frame cada 1/FPS segundos
--       (el acumulado se limita a 0.25 s para no recuperar saltos despues de un lag).
--    f) updateSpriteSheetFrame localiza la hoja del frame, calcula
--         columna = indice % Columns,   fila = floor(indice / Columns)
--       y mueve ImageRectOffset = (columna * FrameWidth, fila * FrameHeight) en la hoja
--       activa (mas CropY si CropContent). Al terminar el ultimo frame vuelve al 0.
--
-- 4) FONDO ESTATICO. En SetTheme, applyImages no pone la imagen de Background mientras
--    haya un sprite activo (self._themeSprite). Si el tema no trae Sprite, o es
--    invalido, se usa Background como siempre.
--
-- 5) REGLA CRITICA - ZIndex. El ScreenGui usa ZIndexBehavior.Global: el orden de
--    dibujo lo decide el ZIndex en TODA la interfaz, no la jerarquia padre/hijo.
--    Las capas del sprite deben tener el MISMO ZIndex que BackgroundArt
--    (parent.ZIndex, hoy 5). Con ZIndex 1 el sprite quedaba debajo de Main (5) y
--    no se veia. Si algun dia cambia el ZIndex de BackgroundArt, el sprite lo sigue.
--
-- COMO AGREGAR UN TEMA CON SPRITE: en el archivo de temas, dentro del tema, agregar
--   Sprite = { SheetIds = {"rbxassetid://..."}, Columns = 4, Rows = 5,
--              FrameWidth = 256, FrameHeight = 192, FramesPerSheet = {20, 20, 8}, FPS = 24 }
-- y subir Version. Subir las hojas como Image y esperar la aprobacion de Roblox.
local function toThemeSpriteConfig(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local ids = raw.SheetIds or raw.Ids
    if type(ids) ~= "table" or #ids == 0 then return nil end

    local columns = tonumber(raw.Columns)
    local rows = tonumber(raw.Rows)
    if not (columns and rows and tonumber(raw.FrameWidth) and tonumber(raw.FrameHeight)) then
        return nil
    end
    local perSheet = math.max(1, math.floor(columns) * math.floor(rows))

    local counts = {}
    if type(raw.FramesPerSheet) == "table" then
        for i = 1, #ids do
            counts[i] = tonumber(raw.FramesPerSheet[i]) or perSheet
        end
    elseif tonumber(raw.FrameCount) then
        local remaining = tonumber(raw.FrameCount)
        for i = 1, #ids do
            if remaining <= 0 then break end
            counts[i] = math.min(perSheet, remaining)
            remaining = remaining - counts[i]
        end
    else
        for i = 1, #ids do
            counts[i] = perSheet
        end
    end

    -- Solo se usan las hojas con frames; una hoja vacia corta la lista.
    local sheetIds, framesPerSheet = {}, {}
    for i = 1, #ids do
        local n = counts[i]
        if not n or n <= 0 then break end
        sheetIds[#sheetIds + 1] = ids[i]
        framesPerSheet[#framesPerSheet + 1] = math.min(math.floor(n), perSheet)
    end
    if #sheetIds == 0 then return nil end

    local cfg = {
        SheetIds = sheetIds,
        Columns = raw.Columns,
        Rows = raw.Rows,
        FrameWidth = raw.FrameWidth,
        FrameHeight = raw.FrameHeight,
        FramesPerSheet = framesPerSheet,
        FPS = raw.FPS or 24,
        CropContent = raw.CropContent == true,
        CropY = raw.CropY,
        CropHeight = raw.CropHeight,
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
    }
    if not normalizeSpriteSheetConfig(cfg) then return nil end
    return cfg
end

local function stopThemeSprite(owner)
    local st = owner and owner._themeSprite
    if not st then return end
    owner._themeSprite = nil
    if st.Connection then
        st.Connection:Disconnect()
    end
    for _, lbl in ipairs(st.Labels) do
        if lbl then
            lbl:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function applyThemeSprite(owner, parent, raw)
    stopThemeSprite(owner)
    if parent then
        parent.ClipsDescendants = false
    end
    local cfg = toThemeSpriteConfig(raw)
    if raw ~= nil and not cfg then
        warn("[YinYang Sprite] Configuración de sprite inválida; se usa la imagen de fondo")
    end
    if not cfg or not parent then return false end

    -- El sprite reemplaza la imagen de fondo mientras este activo.
    parent.Image = ""
    parent.ClipsDescendants = true

    -- ZIndex = el de BackgroundArt (parent.ZIndex). El ScreenGui usa ZIndexBehavior.Global:
    -- con un ZIndex menor (antes 1) el sprite quedaba dibujado DEBAJO de Main/BackgroundArt
    -- y no se veia, aunque el log dijera "Activo".
    local _, state = createSpriteSheetLabels(parent, cfg, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), parent.ZIndex)
    if not state then return false end
    updateSpriteSheetFrame(state, 0)

    local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local conn
    conn = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not parent.Parent then
            conn:Disconnect()
            return
        end
        -- Si el fondo esta oculto (por ejemplo, con video) no avanza ni acumula tiempo.
        if not parent.Visible or PerfOpt.Flags.StaticBackground then
            state.Acc = 0
            return
        end
        state.Acc = state.Acc + dt
        if state.Acc > 0.25 then
            state.Acc = 0.25
        end
        local step = 1 / state.Config.FPS
        local moved = false
        while state.Acc >= step do
            state.Acc = state.Acc - step
            state.Frame = (state.Frame + 1) % state.Config.TotalFrames
            moved = true
        end
        if moved then
            updateSpriteSheetFrame(state, state.Frame)
        end
    end)

    owner._themeSprite = { Labels = state.Labels, Connection = conn }
    local total = 0
    for _, n in ipairs(cfg.FramesPerSheet) do
        total = total + n
    end
    print("[YinYang Sprite] Activo: " .. #cfg.SheetIds .. " hojas, " .. total .. " frames a " .. cfg.FPS .. " FPS")
    return true
end

local ActiveGlowTweens = {}

ThemePalettes["SukunaV1"] = ThemePalettes["SukunaV1"] or {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 14),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 50),

    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 25),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(220, 45, 50),
}

local function stopGlowTweens(key)
    if ActiveGlowTweens[key] then
        for _, tw in ipairs(ActiveGlowTweens[key]) do
            pcall(function() tw:Cancel() end)
        end
        ActiveGlowTweens[key] = nil
    end
end

StickerPalettes["Sonrisa"] = StickerPalettes["Sonrisa"] or { Image = "rbxassetid://135857695171095", LabelES = "Sonrisa",  LabelEN = "Smile"     }

local function setGlowLayersVisible(frame, visible)
    if not frame.Parent then return end
    local tag = "GLOW_" .. tostring(frame)
    for _, child in ipairs(frame.Parent:GetChildren()) do
        if child:GetAttribute("GlowOwner") == tag then
            child.Visible = visible
        end
    end
end

    Background = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(92, 92, 92),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

local function cleanGlowLayers(frame)
    local tag = "GLOW_" .. tostring(frame)
    if frame.Parent then
        for _, child in ipairs(frame.Parent:GetChildren()) do
            if child:GetAttribute("GlowOwner") == tag then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(70, 35, 20),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(120, 60, 30),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 230),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(220, 180, 150),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(220, 140, 60),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80),
}

local function addGlowSibling(frame, thickness, transparency, color, cornerRadius)
    local container = frame.Parent
    if not container or container:IsA("ScreenGui") or container:IsA("PlayerGui") then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local tag = "GLOW_" .. tostring(frame)
    local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
    layer.Name = "GlowLayer"
    layer:SetAttribute("GlowOwner", tag)
    layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    layer.Size = frame.Size
    layer.Position = frame.Position
    layer.AnchorPoint = frame.AnchorPoint
    layer.ZIndex = math.max(1, frame.ZIndex - 1)
    layer.Parent = container

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = cornerRadius or UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = layer

    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    s.Thickness = thickness
    s.Transparency = transparency
    s.Color = color
    s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
    s.Parent = layer

    return layer, s
end

ThemePalettes["White"] = ThemePalettes["White"] or {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(232, 232, 232),
    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120),
    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89),
}

local function buildGlowOnStroke(frame, accentColor, cornerRadius)
    local key = tostring(frame)
    stopGlowTweens(key)

    local existingStroke = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if not existingStroke then return end

    local _isMainFrame = frame.Name == "Main"
    existingStroke.Color = _isMainFrame and accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)

    local oldGrad = existingStroke:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
    if oldGrad then oldGrad:Destroy() end

    local _bDark  = _isMainFrame and accentColor or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    local _bWhite = _isMainFrame and (Theme.BorderLight or Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40)) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    if _isMainFrame and Theme.BorderLight2 then
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,     _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.330, _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.335, _bWhite),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.665, Theme.BorderLight2),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.670, _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,     _bDark),
        })
    else
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,     _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.330, _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.335, _bWhite),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.665, _bWhite),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.670, _bDark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,     _bDark),
        })
    end
    grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    grad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.5, 0)
    grad.Parent = existingStroke

    local sweepTween = TweenService:Create(
        grad,
        TweenInfo.new(3.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false),
        { Offset = Vector2.new(1.5, 0) }
    )
    sweepTween:Play()

    local pulseTween = TweenService:Create(
        existingStroke,
        TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
        { Transparency = 0.0 }
    )
    pulseTween:Play()

    ActiveGlowTweens[key] = { sweepTween, pulseTween }
end

ThemePalettes["Green"] = ThemePalettes["Green"] or {

    AccentOff = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 90),

    Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 140),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 160),
    ToggleOn = Color3.fromRGB(100, 220, 140),
}

local function buildAnimatedBorder(frame, accentColor, cornerRadius, forceStrokeOnly)
    local key = tostring(frame)
    stopGlowTweens(key)
    cleanGlowLayers(frame)

    local cr = cornerRadius or UDim.new(0, 10)
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(accentColor)
    local accentLight = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(0, s - 0.3), math.min(1, v + 0.25))
    local accentDark  = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.min(1, s + 0.1), math.max(0, v - 0.25))

    local parentIsScreenGui = frame.Parent and (frame.Parent:IsA("ScreenGui") or frame.Parent:IsA("PlayerGui"))
    
    if forceStrokeOnly or parentIsScreenGui then
        buildGlowOnStroke(frame, accentColor, cr)
        return
    end

    local _, outerStroke = addGlowSibling(frame, 16, 0.45, accentColor, cr)
    local _, innerStroke = addGlowSibling(frame, 5, 0.10, accentLight, cr)

    if not outerStroke or not innerStroke then
        buildGlowOnStroke(frame, accentColor, cr)
        return
    end

    local _bDark2  = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    local _bWhite2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,     _bDark2),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.330, _bDark2),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.335, _bWhite2),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.665, _bWhite2),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.670, _bDark2),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,     _bDark2),
    })
    grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    grad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1.5, 0)
    grad.Parent = innerStroke

    local sweepTween = TweenService:Create(
        grad,
        TweenInfo.new(3.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false),
        { Offset = Vector2.new(1.5, 0) }
    )
    sweepTween:Play()

    local pulseTween = TweenService:Create(
        outerStroke,
        TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true),
        { Transparency = 0.20, Thickness = 22 }
    )
    pulseTween:Play()

    ActiveGlowTweens[key] = { sweepTween, pulseTween }
end

local function resetScrollTop(scrollingFrame)
    task.defer(function()
        if scrollingFrame and scrollingFrame.Parent then
            scrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        end
    end)
end

local function formatDuration(totalSeconds)
    totalSeconds = math.floor(totalSeconds)
    local h = math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600)
    local m = math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60)
    local s = totalSeconds % 60
    return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
end

local function createStatGrid(parent)
    local Grid = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 9
    })
    mk("UIGridLayout", {
        CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
        CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 54),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    }, Grid)
    return Grid
end

local function createStatTile(grid, labelSpanish, labelEnglish)
    labelEnglish = labelEnglish or labelSpanish
    local Tile = mk("Frame", {
        Parent = grid,
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
        ZIndex = 9
    })
    Tile:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    corner(Tile, 6)
    stroke(Tile, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.6)

    local TileLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = Tile,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 6),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = GetText(labelSpanish, labelEnglish),
        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        ZIndex = 10
    })
    TileLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "TextDim")
    TileLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", labelSpanish)
    TileLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", labelEnglish)

    local ValueText = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = Tile,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 24),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "...",
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 15,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        ZIndex = 10
    })
    ValueText:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Text")

    return Tile, ValueText
end

local function getContrastColor(bgColor)
    local luminance = 0.299 * bgColor.R + 0.587 * bgColor.G + 0.114 * bgColor.B
    if luminance > 0.6 then
        return Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    end
    return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- ROWKIT: estilo compartido de filas (toggles, botones) y sus controles
-- ============================================================================
local RowKit = {IDLE = 0.42, HOVER = 0.28}

function RowKit.Card(holder)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = RowKit.IDLE
    local c = holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if c then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14) end
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    g.Rotation = 90
    g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.3),
    })
    g.Parent = holder
end

function RowKit.Chip(label, role)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
    label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    label.BackgroundColor3 = Theme[role] or Theme.AccentOff
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
    label:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", role)
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    label.TextSize = 10
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    c.Parent = label
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.Parent = label
end

function RowKit.Control(btn, accent)
    pcall(function() btn.AutoButtonColor = false end)
    local c = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
    if c then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9) end
    if accent then
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
        btn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        if btn:IsA("TextButton") then
            btn.TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            btn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "AccentText")
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            btn.TextSize = 15
        end
    else
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        btn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    end
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    scale.Parent = btn
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.07), {Scale = 0.86}):Play()
    end)
    local function release()
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(release)
end

function RowKit.Press(holder)
    local scale = holder:FindFirstChild("RowPressScale")
    if not scale then
        scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Name = "RowPressScale"
        scale.Parent = holder
    end
    scale.Scale = 0.975
    TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end

-- Mini interfaz que muestra los 8 colores de un tema (tarjetas de temas y editor)
function RowKit.ThemeMock(parent, z)
    local m = {}
    local function f(props, par)
        local o = Instance.new("Frame")
        o.BorderSizePixel = 0
        for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
